table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	icode,
	openingbal=dbo.udf_openingstocksingleitem(:ar_startdate,icode),
	looseqty=max(looseqty),
	d1qty=isnull(sum(d1qty),0),
	d2qty=isnull(sum(d2qty),0), 
	d3qty=isnull(sum(d3qty),0), 
	d4qty=isnull(sum(d4qty),0), 
	d5qty=isnull(sum(d5qty),0), 
	d6qty=isnull(sum(d6qty),0), 
	d7qty=isnull(sum(d7qty),0), 
	d8qty=isnull(sum(d8qty),0), 
	d9qty=isnull(sum(d9qty),0), 
	d10qty=isnull(sum(d10qty),0), 
	d11qty=isnull(sum(d11qty),0), 
	d12qty=isnull(sum(d12qty),0), 
	d13qty=isnull(sum(d13qty),0), 
	d14qty=isnull(sum(d14qty),0), 
	d15qty=isnull(sum(d15qty),0), 
	d16qty=isnull(sum(d16qty),0), 
	
	itemname,
	purchaseqty=max(purchaseqty),
	itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory  where itemcategory.icatcode=:ar_catcode)


FROM
(
SELECT 
	I.ICode,
	openingbal=0,
	looseqty=0,
	d1qty=(0),
	d2qty=0, 
	d3qty=0, 
	d4qty=0, 
	d5qty=0, 
	d6qty=0, 
	d7qty=0, 
	d8qty=0, 
	d9qty=0, 
	d10qty=0, 
	d11qty=0, 
	d12qty=0, 
	d13qty=0, 
	d14qty=0, 
	d15qty=0, 
	d16qty=0, 
	
	itemname=I.name,
	purchaseqty=(select isnull(sum(PD.looseqty+PD.packqty*PD.packunits),0) 
			from Purledger PL, purdetail PD 
			where PL.Postdate>=:ar_startdate and postdate<=:ar_enddate AND
				PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode AND
				PD.icode=I.icode)
FROM Item I
WHERE I.icatcode IN (:ar_catcode)
union all
SELECT 
	icode,
	openingbal=0,
	looseqty,
	d1qty=(case  when monthday in (1,16) then looseqty else 0 end),
	d2qty=(case  when monthday in (2,17) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d3qty=(case  when monthday in (3,18) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d4qty=(case  when monthday in (4,19) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d5qty=(case  when monthday in (5,20) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d6qty=(case  when monthday in (6,21) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d7qty=(case  when monthday in (7,22) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d8qty=(case  when monthday in (8,23) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d9qty=(case  when monthday in (9,24) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d10qty=(case  when monthday in (10,25) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d11qty=(case  when monthday in (11,26) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d12qty=(case  when monthday in (12,27) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d13qty=(case  when monthday in (13,28) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d14qty=(case  when monthday in (14,29) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d15qty=(case  when monthday in (15,30) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	d16qty=(case  when monthday in (31) then looseqty else 0 end), 
	
	itemname=(select name from item where item.icode=SALE.icode),
	purchaseqty=0

FROM (select SD.icode,isnull(sum(SD.looseqty),0)as looseqty,datepart(day,SL.Date) as monthday
			from 	saledetail SD,
					saleledger SL,
					Item ITM
			where 	SL.date>=:ar_startdate and SL.date<=:ar_enddate AND
						SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode AND
						SD.icode=ITM.icode AND
						ITM.icatcode=:ar_catcode 
			group by datepart(day,SL.Date),
	 					SD.icode
			)as SALE
) AS SM

GROUP BY 	SM.icode,
	 			SM.itemname,
	 			SM.openingbal
	 

ORDER BY 	itemname,
				SM.icode

objects.name: c_total_sale_qty
objects.expression: d1qty  +  d2qty  +  d3qty  +  d4qty  +  d5qty  +  d6qty  +  d7qty  +  d8qty  +  d9qty  +  d10qty  +  d11qty  +  d12qty  +  d13qty  +  d14qty  +  d15qty  +  d16qty
